name: What is the typical process for a whole-house window replacement project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a whole-house window replacement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation and estimate, where your needs are assessed, and window options are discussed. Next, precise measurements are taken, and windows are ordered. Once the new windows arrive, old windows are carefully removed, and the new ones are installed, sealed, and insulated. Finally, the work area is cleaned, and a final inspection is performed. A reputable contractor will keep you informed at each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, precise measurements, window ordering, removal of old windows, installation and sealing of new windows, cleanup, and a final inspection.
